summary: Scoped Part 2 of the FellowScript reach research: find larger-scale distribution channels/partnerships/platforms (RightNow Media, denominational networks, curriculum publishers, ChMS marketplaces/integrations, podcasts/YouTube, Facebook/online communities, App Store placement) for reaching church small-group leaders and pastors, building directly on Part 1's conclusion (job-board identification, faith.tools + SGN conferences as small-scale channels, free-tier pitch) without re-litigating settled ground from the marketing overview's two prior runs (leader-first over institutional partnerships; referral over paid ads). Requires every channel to carry a sourced reach figure and an explicit actionable-now-for-a-small-team vs. requires-leverage-not-yet-held classification.
